title: Petition of Southern Union Company for authorization and approval pursuant to G.L. c. 164, §14 to: (1) enter into a long-term $400 million revolving credit agreement providing borrowing capacity up to $230 million beyond the company's recently authorized long-term debt issuance; and (2) to issue up to $130 million in common stock for the purpose of refinancing outstanding debt.
